data.long_meaning: The name Feeroz is derived from the Arabic root 'furz' which means 'to conquer' or 'to win'. This name signifies a victorious and courageous person, a lion among men. During his reign, he undertook several major construction projects, including the famous complex of monuments in Mehrauli called Tughlakabad Fort and Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra.

He is also known as Firuz Shah I and is considered one of the greatest Bahmani rulers. During his reign, he expanded the territory of the Bahmani Sultanate, which included parts of present-day Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana. He is also known for his patronage of literature, art, and culture.
